projects.title: PRAM
projects.description:
PRAM (Progressively Replacing Auction Mobility) is a project with the goal of building Bonhams' own in-house bidding engine, gaining control of the end-to-end customer experience and improving business efficiencies for both customers and staff. This project is composed of the following components:

- New Bonhams App: a brand new mobile app which will supports both Bonhams' bidding engine (BBE) auctions and Auction Mobility's bidding engine (AM). The latter will only be supported until the contract with AM ends.
- Registration Engine: the backoffice tool for CS/SD teams to manage customers' registrations and bids for both online and live auctions
- Online Bidding Engine: the online bidding engine system to support online auctions
- Online Lot & Auction Details Page: online auctions lot & auction details page for both the website and the mobile app
- Live Bidding Engine: the live bidding engine system to support live auctions
- Auction Room Display: the auction room display which appears in the room's projector, also known as public bulletin
- Clerk Console: the clerking screen that clerks use during live auctions
- Auctioneer Console: the auctioneer screen that auctioneers use during live auctions
- Live Bidding Page: the live bidding page customers will interact with online during live auctions for both the website and the mobile app
- Live Auctions & Lot Details Page: live auctions lot & auction details page for both the website and the mobile app

projects.title: Bonhams Rebranding
projects.description: Overall rebranding of the Bonhams brand across all touchpoints.

projects.title: BEMA: Hypercare
projects.description: The New Bonhams app was released in the first 2 weeks of April and the hypercare period is an allocated timeframe to closely monitor the app post-go-live.

projects.title: Upgrade Progress
projects.description: Progress is the technology that supports A3. The update of this technology underlying our entire business operations is crucial to ensure business continuity.
projects.impact: Cost savings of £246K/year. Risk mitigation. Enhanced security.

projects.title: PRAM: Online Auctions Hypercare
projects.description: The online bidding engine and registration engine have been completed. The hypercare period is an allocated timeframe to closely monitor online auctions post-go-live. The first online auction to experience the benefits of PRAM is 32018 Jewels Online 11–19 May.
projects.impact: Increased performance, improved UI/UX, better end-to-end customer experience.

projects.title: ARTA: Post-Sale Integration
projects.description: ARTA is a broker for shipping. The post-sale integration with ARTA will allow customers to self-serve their shipping needs without having to contact CS. Originally this project was only going to be enabled on the website but as a side-benefit of project PRAM, this integration will also be available on the mobile app.
projects.impact: Improved post-sale experience for customers. Saving staff time.
